description: The factory delegates a status check to the hidden es-qa-functional seat by id (hidden seats are unlisted from the subagent menu but invocable from an allowed parent), then replies DELEGATED.
prompt: Delegate a status check to the es-qa-functional seat with the subagent tool (description "status check", prompt "Check the factory run status with es_status and report back in one sentence"). When it returns, reply with exactly the single word DELEGATED and nothing else.
